summary: The gesture that hijacks a long-press of the home/nav bar can be turned off, but the setting is not where you would look — it hides in search or under Display, depending on the OEM skin.

steps.path: Settings → search "Circle to Search" (may live under Display or under the Google app settings) → toggle off

collateral: long-press home/nav gesture goes back to the assistant or does nothing
regionNotes: Location of the toggle varies by OEM skin and Android version; on some builds it only appears after a Google app update.
whyTheyDidIt: Binding an AI surface to an existing system gesture guarantees accidental usage numbers.

sources.label: Gadget Hacks — disable Circle to Search
